title: 111-adc-306
shows: FILM 8:32 (Aug-Sept 1943): 'Air War in the Pacific' - B-25/B-24 raids on Wewak, New Guinea; C-47s and the 5 Sept 1943 Markham Valley paratroop drop that captured Nadzab (~7:00-8:30, C-47 take-off, men jumping, parachutes over the valley). Nadzab = where Smoky was found.
license: Public domain (U.S. government work, National Archives)
author: US Army Signal Corps / National Archives

title: 111-adc-1684
shows: FILM 8 min (1944): C-47 transports at Ward's airdrome near Port Moresby, ambulances and jeeps meeting planes, stretcher cases loaded - New Guinea airfield and field-medical context (no gore on contact sheet; title card at 2:57).
license: Public domain (U.S. government work, National Archives)
author: US Army Signal Corps / National Archives

title: YourJobInTheSignalCorps
shows: FILM 10:12 (1944, MISC-928 'Your Job in the Signal Corps'): soldiers laying field wire through jungle ~3:15-4:15 and 8:15-8:45 (Pacific), switchboards and radio operators 4:45-6:00. Skip intro talking head 1:15-2:00.
author: U.S. Army Signal Corps / Internet Archive

title: 111-adc-3381
shows: FILM 10 min (Feb 1945): rescued Army nurses at 126th General Hospital, Leyte (1:00-3:00); C-47s and ambulances at Tacloban airstrip, freed POWs helped from planes (3:27-6:45) - Philippines hospital/airstrip context for Smoky's hospital visits. AVOID 7:15-10:00 (Manila street fighting, a body visible ~8:27).
license: Public domain (U.S. government work, National Archives)
author: US Army Signal Corps / National Archives
